title: Needed+
description: A basic mod that adds new items, food, ores, tools, recipes, ETC.
body:
WARNING: if you want the mod to work, use 1.3.0. --- A basic survival mod that adds a bunch of new stuff! Foods, ores, recipes, ETC.

Base example---



Foods : Guardian meat, Dough, Crackers, Bucket o' berries, Berry juice, Flour, -and alot more.

Ores + Related : Fireite, Fireite shard, Fireite ingot-New "Obsidian Shard" and "Obsidian Ingot" [the ores and tools may have already been added, if they havent I will do it in a future update] and obsidian tools.

Recipes : Saddle, Totem, and add suggestions for other recipes in the comments if you want.



I am planning to add a new dimension or biome soon. Enjoy!
